context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets carrying 1Hz Telemetry Samples with t_device from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; device-initiated, immediate.
context_map.boundary_protection: Device payload model is adopted as-is; Sensor Metric Boundary validation, VALIDATION_FAILED tagging and t_device ordering protect internals; t_ingress never used for ordering. Open: delivery posture/retry identity undefined.

context_map.exchanged_information: Events TelemetrySampleIngested, TelemetrySampleValidationFailed, TelemetrySampleBackfilled, TelemetryRevisionAppended; eventual, backpressure-aware.
context_map.boundary_protection: Only published events cross; raw append-only store, revision history and reorder internals never leak. Distribution holds derived window buffers only. Flag: Distribution invariant says only validated samples propagate, yet it consumes TelemetrySampleValidationFailed; filtering rule needs owner decision.

context_map.exchanged_information: WindowedTelemetryBroadcast to downstream event streams / streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
context_map.boundary_protection: Stable windowed-stream contract; consumers do not access raw records or ingestion internals; broadcast honours downstream demand without blocking I/O.

cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: immediate for validation and append; late/backfilled data within 60s reordered by t_device
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Open: handling of packets later than 60s; bounds missing for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke, swim pace upper bound.

Failure posture: demand-driven backpressure; consumers idempotent on revision/backfill events. All 4 published events consumed; no unmatched terms. No coupling cycles (one-way flow). Context split is a low-confidence assumption.
